heading: `realtime`
text:
### `realtime` [LCAP.2.1]

A strategy capability. `realtime: true` imposes a two-phase lifecycle: **INIT** (schema load, pool allocation,
presz, intern lock) and **LIVE** (pump only; zero allocation; bounded
execution).  Entry via `go_live`.

In LIVE mode every hash table, pool, and scratch buffer is pre-sized;
no `malloc`/`realloc` call may occur.  Every alpha test, join, TMS
operation, and TTL tick must complete within the T_wcet budget.

`realtime: true` requires `constspace: true` ([LCAP.3.7]), and the compiler
runs every `constspace` check under it ([LCAP.2.6]).

It leaves every other setting to the program. With `linear_scan: true` a
join may scan, and its cost is bounded by the working-memory capacity
rather than constant; with `logical: true` the TMS is present but
`rt_locked`; with `dynamic_ttl: false` the TTL queue is the per-schema FIFO.
